Gross transfers Nu. 35,250,000 (primary, five parties) and Nu. 14,100,000 (general) not stored — campaign-fund rows are disbursed-minus-refunded. Per-party/candidate average rows and named candidate refunds not collected. sitting_total_reconstructed is the printed combined total, not a sum invented off-page. Named private donors not collected.
